notes: Rebuilt FEHA body armor around seven active manufacturers with distinct AC, pricing, weight, Dexterity contribution, and one simple signature effect per company.
ForgeLine Industries is the heaviest raw-protection line; Bastion Strategic sits just below it as more measured tactical military armor.
Jade Arc Systems now owns heavy energy armor with lightning resistance and EMP-save advantage. Corvus Neural armor is expensive neural-security gear with Quickhack-save bonuses.

Vektor Dynamics armor is adaptive medium armor with up to +2 Dexterity contribution. Helix Vitae armor emphasizes movement speed. Kurohane Group armor uses full Dexterity contribution and adds Stealth bonuses.
Armor prices now treat armor as permanent progression gear: Mk I is attainable, Mk III is a serious restricted purchase, and Mk V is expensive endgame equipment.

Lumen Optics is retired as a manufacturer. Redundant Lumen armor and mod leftovers are removed; useful Lumen weapons, cyberware, grenades, and consumables are reassigned to surviving manufacturers and stale Lumen descriptions/company metadata are rewritten.
The canonical armor catalog contains 35 pieces: seven manufacturers with Mk I through Mk V.
Armor runtime connects Bastion weapon-hit damage reduction, Jade Arc custom lightning/EMP protection, and Corvus Quickhack defense to live mechanics.
